sentences.en: The war in Ukraine has now been underway for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰战争现在已经持续两周了。

sentences.en: But Russia has yet to take control of any major Ukrainian cities, except for the southern port of Kherson.

sentences.en: This huge, high-tech Russian army, nearly 200,000 soldiers, has failed to take Kharkiv.

sentences.en: It's failed to take Odessa, and it's failed to take Kiev.

sentences.en: So the state of this war is perhaps best described as eerily stalled.
sentences.zh: 所以这场战争的状态或许最好被描述为令人不安的僵持。

sentences.en: And for Russia, their answer is to encircle these cities and, from a distance, bomb what they can't control.
sentences.zh: 而对于俄罗斯来说，他们的对策是包围这些城市，并从远处轰炸他们无法控制的目标。

sentences.en: Over and over.

sentences.en: And what Russia is hitting now seems indiscriminate.

sentences.en: Apartment buildings, factories, universities, hospitals.

sentences.en: Since the war started, there have been more than 700 Russian missile attacks.

sentences.en: And the dead are overwhelmingly Ukrainian civilians.
sentences.zh: 死者绝大多数是乌克兰平民。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Michael Schwartz and Valerie Hopkins send us dispatches on two of those cities in Ukraine's south that are now surrounded and under attack.

sentences.en: While we were there checking out this tank, a group of Ukrainian soldiers ran up to us and told us that they had had a call.
sentences.zh: 当我们正在检查这辆坦克时，一群乌克兰士兵跑过来告诉我们，他们接到了警报。

sentences.en: A Russian helicopter was incoming, and that we had to get out.
sentences.zh: 一架俄罗斯直升机正在靠近，我们必须离开。

sentences.en: Helicopter.
sentences.zh: 直升机。

sentences.en: Helicopter, walking, walking, walking.
sentences.zh: 直升机，快走，快走，快走。

sentences.en: Helicopter.
sentences.zh: 直升机。

sentences.en: We got a helicopter coming, we gotta run.
sentences.zh: 有直升机来了，我们得跑。

sentences.en: Back to the car.
sentences.zh: 回到车里。

sentences.en: Pass the tank.
sentences.zh: 经过那辆坦克。

sentences.en: Oh yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，好的。

sentences.en: Helicopter.
sentences.zh: 直升机。

sentences.en: Wish we probably not.
sentences.zh: 真希望我们没遇到。

sentences.en: Probably don't want to meet.
sentences.zh: 大概不想碰上它。

sentences.en: The sun is up over Mikolaev now.
sentences.zh: 太阳现在已经升起在尼古拉耶夫上空了。

sentences.en: We were woken up about five in the morning with a massive Russian artillery barrage that lit up the sky over large swaths of the city.
sentences.zh: 凌晨五点左右，我们被一阵猛烈的俄罗斯炮火惊醒，炮火照亮了城市大片区域的天空。

sentences.en: This is a day after Ukrainian forces pushed Russian troops outside of the city limits and retook the airport.
sentences.zh: 这是乌克兰军队将俄军赶出城市范围并夺回机场后的第二天。

sentences.en: We'd been told that the Russians were mounting their forces for a counterattack, and that seems to have begun.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知俄军正在集结兵力进行反击，看来反击已经开始了。

sentences.en: It's about eight o'clock now, and the artillery firing is still going on, and there's smoke over the city.
sentences.zh: 现在大约八点钟，炮击仍在继续，城市上空弥漫着烟雾。

sentences.en: A short time later, Tyler and I set out into the city to find the area's hardest hit.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，泰勒和我出发前往城里，寻找受灾最严重的地区。

sentences.en: They're trying to talk to me, and I'm...
sentences.zh: 他们正试图跟我说话，而我……

sentences.en: And we came across a woman named Olga.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了一个叫奥尔加的女人。

sentences.en: Her apartment building was cracked open.
sentences.zh: 她的公寓楼被炸开了。

sentences.en: There was a large hole straight through the middle of it from where a Russian rocket had hit.
sentences.zh: 由于一枚俄罗斯火箭弹的击中，楼房中间被炸出了一个大洞。

sentences.en: There was glass everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是玻璃碎片。

sentences.en: Not a single window had glass in it.
sentences.zh: 没有一扇窗户还留有玻璃。

sentences.en: Debris had rained down on the street below.
sentences.zh: 碎片像雨点般落到下方的街道上。

sentences.en: And people were, in each of the windows, trying to clean up the wreckage of their homes.
sentences.zh: 人们在每一扇窗户前，试图清理他们家园的残骸。

sentences.en: Olga was one of them.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加就是其中之一。

sentences.en: I started talking to her and asking about what she went through the night before.
sentences.zh: 我开始和她交谈，询问她前一天晚上经历了什么。

sentences.en: She told me she lived through a nightmare, that she was woken up at 5 a.m., and that she'd hid in the bathroom with her child.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我她经历了一场噩梦，凌晨5点被惊醒，然后和孩子躲在浴室里。

sentences.en: She asked why we were there doing this, why we were interviewing her, and whether that would help her at all.
sentences.zh: 她问我们为什么要在这里做这些，为什么要采访她，以及这是否真的能帮到她。

sentences.en: And then she turned her anger on President Vladimir Putin of Russia, saying that he's killing peaceful people.
sentences.zh: 然后她将愤怒转向了俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，说他在杀害平民。

sentences.en: And for what, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，这一切究竟是为了什么？

sentences.en: So that the Ukrainian people could somehow be under him.
sentences.zh: 难道就是为了让乌克兰人民屈服于他吗？

sentences.en: And I asked her at what point, what else she'd want to tell Vladimir Putin, if she could.
sentences.zh: 我问她，如果可以的话，她还想对弗拉基米尔·普京说些什么。

sentences.en: And first she said nothing.
sentences.zh: 起初她说没什么可说的。

sentences.en: And then she said she wanted him to suffer the same way that she had suffered that morning.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，她希望他能遭受她那天早上所经历的同样的痛苦。

sentences.en: For more than a week now, this has been the reality for so many people in this city, Mikolayev.
sentences.zh: 一个多星期以来，这就是尼古拉耶夫这座城市里许多人的现实。

sentences.en: Even now, as I'm recording this, shelling is going on outside.
sentences.zh: 即使现在，当我录制这段话时，外面仍在炮击。

sentences.en: And I can't tell you for certain whether it's Ukrainians firing out or the Russians firing in.
sentences.zh: 我无法确定到底是乌克兰人在向外开火，还是俄罗斯人在向内轰炸。

sentences.en: And every day I wake up sort of wondering how much longer this town and these people and this small Ukrainian force that's defending it can hold on.
sentences.zh: 每天醒来，我都在想，这座城市、这些人民以及这支保卫它的小型乌克兰部队还能坚持多久。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，你每晚也要带着300件最珍贵的收藏去工作。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、展示着精美50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，去探索《时报》呢？

sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: This is Valerie Hopkins.
sentences.zh: 我是瓦莱丽·霍普金斯。

sentences.en: I've been reporting from Ukraine since before the war started.
sentences.zh: 战争开始前我就一直在乌克兰进行报道。

sentences.en: And this week, I've been trying to report on the city of Mariupol, which is a port city in the southeast of Ukraine that's just 35 miles from the Russian border.
sentences.zh: 本周，我一直在尝试报道马里乌波尔，这是一座位于乌克兰东南部、距离俄罗斯边境仅35英里的港口城市。

sentences.en: Right now, it's the last city in a critical swatch of territory for moving supplies and troops that's holding out against Russian control.
sentences.zh: 目前，它是这片对于运送物资和部队至关重要的领土上，最后一个抵御俄罗斯控制的城市。

sentences.en: Mariupol has been surrounded on all sides for a week by Russian forces.
sentences.zh: 马里乌波尔已经被俄罗斯军队从四面八方包围了一周。

sentences.en: And the city is slowly running out of food and water.
sentences.zh: 城市里的食物和水正在慢慢耗尽。

sentences.en: People have been desperately trying to get out.
sentences.zh: 人们一直在拼命地试图逃离。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday, I was able to speak with someone who finally did.
sentences.zh: 周三，我终于采访到了一位成功逃出来的人。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you, too.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Her name is Marina, and she fled Mariupol a few days ago as the situation became increasingly dire.
sentences.zh: 她叫玛丽娜，几天前因为局势日益严峻，她逃离了马里乌波尔。

sentences.en: So how are you?
sentences.zh: 你现在怎么样？

sentences.en: Where are you?
sentences.zh: 你在哪里？

sentences.en: My friend, she has a flat in Viv.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友在利沃夫有一套公寓。

sentences.en: So I came here, and actually, it's such kind of relief because it was really hard to be in Mariupol.
sentences.zh: 所以我来到这里，这真是一种解脱，因为在马里乌波尔真的太难熬了。

sentences.en: But now it's even harder there.
sentences.zh: 但现在那里更艰难了。

sentences.en: I don't know how people are surviving there.
sentences.zh: 我不知道人们是怎么在那里生存下来的。

sentences.en: My parents left there, and my husband left there as well.
sentences.zh: 我的父母离开了那里，我丈夫也离开了。

sentences.en: Oh, they're still left there?
sentences.zh: 噢，他们还留在那里吗？

sentences.en: They're still there, yeah.
sentences.zh: 他们还在那里，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 我太难过了。

sentences.en: And can you communicate with them at all?
sentences.zh: 你还能和他们联系吗？

sentences.en: There's no cell phone service, right?
sentences.zh: 没有手机信号，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, for a few days, no connection at all.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有几天完全没信号。

sentences.en: But I know what's going on because we have these groups on Telegram.
sentences.zh: 但我知道发生了什么，因为我们有Telegram群组。

sentences.en: The people are putting pictures and videos and sharing the information.
sentences.zh: 人们在群里发布图片和视频，分享信息。

sentences.en: And I'm, you know, I know about what's going on from that groups, not even from the news.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我是从这些群组里了解情况的，甚至不是从新闻里。

sentences.en: People are trying to find their relatives because there is no connection.
sentences.zh: 人们都在试图寻找亲人，因为没有通讯。

sentences.en: And some of the people are in Europe, and they have relatives in Mariupol, and they are texting to this group, please, I will pay money.
sentences.zh: 有些人身在欧洲，他们在马里乌波尔有亲戚，他们会给群里发信息说，求求你们，我愿意付钱。

sentences.en: Can you go and check this address?
sentences.zh: 你能去帮我看看这个地址吗？

sentences.en: Is it somebody alive there?
sentences.zh: 还有人活着吗？

sentences.en: Just please go and check.
sentences.zh: 求求你们去看看。

sentences.en: But yesterday, yeah, my husband get through.
sentences.zh: 但昨天，我丈夫联系上了。

sentences.en: So I talked a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以我聊了一会儿。

sentences.en: And it's actually hard to talk because he is in a panic.
sentences.zh: 其实很难交谈，因为他处于恐慌之中。

sentences.en: He is in a stress.
sentences.zh: 他压力很大。

sentences.en: And I'm trying to talk, and he don't want to tell me anything.
sentences.zh: 我试图说话，但他什么都不想告诉我。

sentences.en: And I'm asking, how are my parents?
sentences.zh: 我问，我父母怎么样了？

sentences.en: They live in the center of Mariupol.
sentences.zh: 他们住在马里乌波尔市中心。

sentences.en: And I said, did you visit them?
sentences.zh: 我说，你去看过他们吗？

sentences.en: He said, no, I can't visit them because it's shooting all the time.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，我没法去看他们，因为一直在开火。

sentences.en: And actually, the center is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，市中心已经被摧毁了。

sentences.en: So he said, maybe today I will go and I will visit them because it's a few hours.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，也许今天我会去看看他们，因为有几个小时。

sentences.en: It's like quiet, you know, no shootings, no explosions.
sentences.zh: 就像是安静了，你知道，没有枪声，没有爆炸。

sentences.en: So this is pretty much how it's been for Marina since she fled Mariupol, trying to piece together
sentences.zh: 这就是玛丽娜逃离马里乌波尔后的生活状态，她试图拼凑起

sentences.en: bits and pieces of information she can get from phone calls and texts when she's able to get through, trying to find out if her family is surviving the Russian assault.
sentences.zh: 她能从电话和短信中得到的零星信息，试图弄清楚她的家人是否能在俄罗斯的袭击中幸存下来。

sentences.en: So he went, and I was just like, can I talk to my parents?
sentences.zh: 所以他去了，我当时就想，我能和父母说话吗？

sentences.en: Can you give a phone?
sentences.zh: 你能把电话给他们吗？

sentences.en: He said, no.
sentences.zh: 他说，不行。

sentences.en: And I'm just like, why?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，为什么？

sentences.en: Why no?
sentences.zh: 为什么不行？

sentences.en: And it's like he's hiding from me something.
sentences.zh: 感觉他好像在对我隐瞒什么。

sentences.en: And I was just like, how is their house?
sentences.zh: 我当时就问，他们的房子怎么样了？

sentences.en: Is it destroyed or not?
sentences.zh: 被毁了吗？

sentences.en: He said, yeah, there are no windows there.
sentences.zh: 他说，是的，那里已经没有窗户了。

sentences.en: And actually, now it's minus eight in Mariupol.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，现在马里乌波尔是零下八度。

sentences.en: And it says this, it will be even more colder soon.
sentences.zh: 据说很快会更冷。

sentences.en: And there is no water, no heating, no gas, no, actually, no food.
sentences.zh: 没有水，没有暖气，没有天然气，实际上，也没有食物。

sentences.en: And they're collecting snow, melting the snow, boiling the snow, and then drinking the snow and maybe cooking.
sentences.zh: 他们正在收集雪，融化雪，煮沸雪，然后喝掉，可能还会用来做饭。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: So what I do know that people, they are cutting the trees around the house, and they are cooking outside, and people trying to survive like this.
sentences.zh: 我知道的是，人们正在砍伐房子周围的树木，在外面做饭，人们就是这样试图生存的。

sentences.en: And actually, yesterday, my husband texted me that I'm in a stress, and I'm asking why it's quiet from you, why you are not texting to me.
sentences.zh: 昨天，我丈夫给我发短信说他压力很大，我问他为什么不联系我，为什么不给我发短信。

sentences.en: You have this chance to talk to me.
sentences.zh: 你有机会和我说话的。

sentences.en: And he said, what can I tell you?
sentences.zh: 他说，我能告诉你什么呢？

sentences.en: There is no water, nothing.
sentences.zh: 没有水，什么都没有。

sentences.en: I'm sleeping on the floor, no windows, and it's explosions everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我睡在地板上，没有窗户，到处都是爆炸。

sentences.en: And I think we have food for a few days left.
sentences.zh: 我想我们的食物只够吃几天了。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: And it's cold, and my shoes are wet all the time, and I can't warm up my feet.
sentences.zh: 而且很冷，我的鞋子总是湿的，我的脚怎么也暖不起来。

sentences.en: And so I don't know if my parents, where can they get the food?
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道我父母他们能从哪里弄到食物。

sentences.en: And thanks God, my parents have a roof.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝，我父母还有个屋顶。

sentences.en: Yeah, they don't have a window, but they have a roof in their house.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们没有窗户，但他们的房子还有个屋顶。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: And so they're staying there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们就待在那里。

sentences.en: How old are they?
sentences.zh: 他们多大年纪了？

sentences.en: Can you tell me a bit about them?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我说说他们的情况吗？

sentences.en: They are almost 70.
sentences.zh: 他们快70岁了。

sentences.en: Quite old, you know, quite old, almost 70 years old.
sentences.zh: 年纪很大了，你知道，年纪很大了，快70岁了。

sentences.en: And I said to them, will you move or something?
sentences.zh: 我对他们说，你们要搬走或者做点什么吗？

sentences.en: And they were just like, too loud.
sentences.zh: 他们只是说，外面声音太大了。

sentences.en: Marina said she asked her parents to leave Mariupol with her, but they didn't see how.
sentences.zh: 玛丽娜说她曾请求父母和她一起离开马里乌波尔，但他们不知道该怎么走。

sentences.en: It was their home, and their lives were built in that city.
sentences.zh: 那是他们的家，他们的一生都建立在那座城市里。

sentences.en: My mom, she was born in Mariupol, and my father, he was a seaman.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈出生在马里乌波尔，我父亲是一名海员。

sentences.en: I was born in Mariupol, like my husband.
sentences.zh: 我和我丈夫一样，都出生在马里乌波尔。

sentences.en: Her mother was born there.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲出生在那里。

sentences.en: Her father worked there as a seaman and saved enough money for them to buy a few apartments that they took care of and rented out for extra money.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲在那里做海员，攒够了钱买了几套公寓，他们平时打理这些公寓并出租以赚取额外收入。

sentences.en: And they couldn't really imagine leaving and starting over.
sentences.zh: 他们真的无法想象离开并从头开始。

sentences.en: And plus, they loved their beautiful house very close to the sea.
sentences.zh: 而且，他们深爱着那座靠近大海的美丽房子。

sentences.en: And so they stayed behind with her husband.
sentences.zh: 所以他们留下来陪她丈夫了。

sentences.en: How old are you, and how old is your husband?
sentences.zh: 你多大？你丈夫多大？

sentences.en: I'm 28, and my husband is 30.
sentences.zh: 我28岁，我丈夫30岁。

sentences.en: He's a taekwondo champion.
sentences.zh: 他曾是跆拳道冠军。

sentences.en: He was a taekwondo champion.
sentences.zh: 他以前是跆拳道冠军。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So he really has lots of medals and everything, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以他真的有很多奖牌之类的，你知道的。

sentences.en: So he's like a well-known guy in a taekwondo sport.
sentences.zh: 他在跆拳道界是个很有名的人。

sentences.en: So there were lots of kids training with him, I think more than 100.
sentences.zh: 我想当时有100多个孩子跟着他训练。

sentences.en: And his kids are world champions in Europe, in the taekwondo.
sentences.zh: 他的学生在欧洲都是跆拳道世界冠军。

sentences.en: And actually, we just married in June the previous year.
sentences.zh: 其实我们去年六月才结婚。

sentences.en: So it's just half a year like we are married.
sentences.zh: 我们结婚才半年左右。

sentences.en: And actually, everything was perfect because my parents, they worked hard all their life to make my future easier, you know.
sentences.zh: 其实一切都很完美，因为我的父母一生都在努力工作，为了让我的未来更轻松，你知道的。

sentences.en: And actually, I can tell the same thing about my husband's parents.
sentences.zh: 其实我丈夫的父母也是一样。

sentences.en: They as well.
sentences.zh: 他们也是。

sentences.en: So we were okay with my husband in miracle terms, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时的生活简直像奇迹一样，你知道的。

sentences.en: We had a car.
sentences.zh: 我们有车。

sentences.en: We had the new flat.
sentences.zh: 我们有新公寓。

sentences.en: And actually, the whole life should be in front of us because we worked and we tried to make our future as easier as possible, you know.
sentences.zh: 其实我们本该拥有大好前程，因为我们努力工作，试图让未来尽可能轻松，你知道的。

sentences.en: We dreamed to travel and we would buy nice frying pans and everything, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们梦想着去旅行，买好的平底锅之类的东西，你知道的。

sentences.en: And we planned that we will have a kid.
sentences.zh: 我们还计划要个孩子。

sentences.en: So it was a normal life, like everybody dreaming to be like this, you know.
sentences.zh: 那是一种正常的生活，每个人都梦想着那样的生活，你知道的。

sentences.en: We never dreamed to leave the miracle.
sentences.zh: 我们从未想过要离开那个奇迹般的地方。

sentences.en: Marina says they just never imagined anything like this could happen.
sentences.zh: 玛丽娜说他们从未想过会发生这样的事。

sentences.en: Even as talk of military conflict grew, she said no one in her town, no one in her family expected that a war could go on like this.
sentences.zh: 她说，即使军事冲突的传言越来越多，她镇上和家里也没有人预料到战争会演变成这样。

sentences.en: Nobody expected it's going to be like that because we had already a war in 2014 and it was not so big, yeah.
sentences.zh: 没人预料到会变成这样，因为我们在2014年已经经历过一次战争，当时规模没那么大，是吧。

sentences.en: They'd experienced war back in 2014 when Russia annexed Crimea, which is nearby, and forces loyal to Moscow took over Mariupol briefly.
sentences.zh: 他们在2014年俄罗斯吞并附近的克里米亚时就经历过战争，当时效忠莫斯科的武装力量曾短暂占领马里乌波尔。

sentences.en: Yeah, a few houses were destroyed, but not the center, you know.
sentences.zh: 是的，当时有几栋房子被毁，但不是市中心，你知道的。

sentences.en: And people, yes, people left in 2014.
sentences.zh: 而且人们，是的，人们在2014年确实离开了。

sentences.en: They left and then they came back and built everything from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 他们离开了，后来又回来，从头开始重建一切。

sentences.en: So it was kind of a lesson.
sentences.zh: 所以那算是一种教训吧。

sentences.en: So that's why when we found out that there was going to be the war, we thought it would be something light, you know, not so hard like it's now.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么当我们发现要打仗时，我们以为会像以前一样轻松，你知道的，不会像现在这么艰难。

sentences.en: It will be something like in 2014.
sentences.zh: 会像2014年那样。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was quite scary in 2014, but not like this.
sentences.zh: 是的，2014年确实很吓人，但没到这种程度。

sentences.en: So that's why people were quite relaxed and they stayed in Morocco.
sentences.zh: 所以人们当时很放松，留在了马里乌波尔。

sentences.en: And actually, nobody knew that it will be no food, no water.
sentences.zh: 其实没人知道后来会断粮断水。

sentences.en: Yeah, we had an expectation that it's going to be hard and we bought some extra food, you know, for a hard time.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们预料到日子会很难过，所以买了一些额外的食物，你知道的，为了应对困难时期。

sentences.en: But nobody knew that it's going to be this.
sentences.zh: 但没人知道会变成现在这样。

sentences.en: But soon the provisions started to run out as Russian forces were strangling the city.
sentences.zh: 但随着俄军对城市的围困，补给很快就开始耗尽了。

sentences.en: And we can't move because it's shooting all the time from the Russian side.
sentences.zh: 我们没法动弹，因为俄军一直在开火。

sentences.en: The shelling and bombing campaign also persisted and Marina began to see people lying dead in the streets.
sentences.zh: 炮击和轰炸持续不断，玛丽娜开始看到街上躺着死者。

sentences.en: And the bodies are laying covered on the streets.
sentences.zh: 尸体就那样被盖着躺在街上。

sentences.en: And actually, we got the message.
sentences.zh: 其实，我们收到了一条消息。

sentences.en: I've got the message on my cell phone from, I don't know what kind of organization it was,
sentences.zh: 我的手机收到了一条消息，不知道是哪个组织发的，

sentences.en: but it says that if somebody will die in your family, just put the body outside, tie the hands
sentences.zh: 但上面说，如果家里有人去世，就把尸体放在外面，绑住手

sentences.en: and the legs and let it be outside, or if you can, dig it under the ground, if you can.
sentences.zh: 和脚，让它留在外面，或者如果可以的话，尽量把它埋在地下。

sentences.en: If not, just leave it and cover it.
sentences.zh: 如果不行，就把它留在那里盖好。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: So now it's what's going on in Morocco.
sentences.zh: 这就是马里乌波尔现在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Bodies are there and just staying there.
sentences.zh: 尸体就在那里，一直留在那里。

sentences.en: And everything happened so quick that I can't even, can't even believe, you know.
sentences.zh: 一切发生得太快了，我甚至不敢相信，你知道的。

sentences.en: And my life was destroyed like this in a minute.
sentences.zh: 我的生活就这样在一分钟内被摧毁了。

sentences.en: Can you tell a little bit about how you finally made the decision?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈你是如何最终做出决定的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I think that for everyone that I talk to, you know, the hardest part is to decide because, you know, you're in this horrible position for so long without, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得对于我交谈过的每个人来说，最难的就是做决定，因为你长期处于这种可怕的境地，没有，你知道的，

sentences.en: without food and water, and then you have to make a decision that's going to change your life.
sentences.zh: 没有食物和水，然后你必须做出一个改变你一生的决定。

sentences.en: Can you talk a little bit about the decision-making process, like how you decided to leave?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈做决定的过程吗？比如你是怎么决定离开的？

sentences.en: And who you went with and, yeah, and what you were kind of weighing in your mind about whether to stay or go or...
sentences.zh: 你是和谁一起走的？你在决定留下还是离开时，心里在权衡什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was hard to decide to leave.
sentences.zh: 是的，决定离开很难。

sentences.en: But actually, my husband, he said, pack your stuff, pack the suitcase, and if it will be a chance, you will leave.
sentences.zh: 但其实我丈夫对我说，收拾好东西，打包好行李，如果有机会，你就离开。

sentences.en: And I was just like, no, I will not leave you.
sentences.zh: 我当时就说，不，我不会离开你。

sentences.en: I will not go from Marupo.
sentences.zh: 我不会离开马里乌波尔。

sentences.en: I will not leave my parents.
sentences.zh: 我不会离开我的父母。

sentences.en: And he said, I will try to care about your parents.
sentences.zh: 他说，我会试着照顾你的父母。

sentences.en: If you will stay, you're just probably going to die with us or something like that.
sentences.zh: 如果你留下来，你很可能会和我们一起死，或者发生类似的事情。

sentences.en: So you just, if it will be a chance, you will go, he said.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，如果有机会，你就走。

sentences.en: And I cried, but I packed my stuff.
sentences.zh: 我哭了，但我还是收拾了行李。

sentences.en: But I swear, I wasn't...
sentences.zh: 但我发誓，我当时并没有……

sentences.en: It was for sure for me that I will not leave, you know.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常确定我不会离开，你知道的。

sentences.en: So in a few days, he came and he said, yeah, let's go and leave your suitcase.
sentences.zh: 几天后，他来了，说，走吧，把行李箱留下。

sentences.en: You can't take the suitcase.
sentences.zh: 你不能带行李箱。

sentences.en: Take just a small bag.
sentences.zh: 只带一个小包。

sentences.en: And we will try to put in a car as many people as we can.
sentences.zh: 我们要尽量在车里多塞几个人。

sentences.en: So you can't take your suitcase.
sentences.zh: 所以你不能带行李箱。

sentences.en: So I took the small bag and he just put me in a car with his parents, with my father-in-law and my mom-in-law and a few girls been there.
sentences.zh: 所以我拿了一个小包，他把我塞进车里，和我公婆以及几个女孩在一起。

sentences.en: One of the girls, it's my friend.
sentences.zh: 其中一个女孩是我的朋友。

sentences.en: And we moved.
sentences.zh: 我们就出发了。

sentences.en: She went on to tell me the story of how she made her way out of the encircled city.
sentences.zh: 她接着向我讲述了她如何逃离那座被围困城市的故事。

sentences.en: As they drove west, they had to pass through a series of checkpoints controlled by Russian troops.
sentences.zh: 当他们向西行驶时，必须经过一系列由俄军控制的检查站。

sentences.en: And they decide it's better to travel through smaller back roads, getting help from villagers along the way to avoid checkpoints, until they finally make it to western Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他们决定最好走偏僻的小路，沿途寻求村民的帮助以避开检查站，直到最终到达乌克兰西部。

sentences.en: I'm sitting in Vyv and I'm crying, actually.
sentences.zh: 我现在坐在利沃夫，其实我在哭。

sentences.en: I think for me, it was easier even to be there, you know, to be without water, without heating, without food.
sentences.zh: 我觉得对我来说，待在那里甚至更容易，你知道的，没有水，没有暖气，没有食物。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 那都无所谓。

sentences.en: But I was with my relatives.
sentences.zh: 因为我和我的亲人在一起。

sentences.en: And now I don't know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 而现在我不知道那边发生了什么。

sentences.en: And actually, I texted to my husband yesterday and I said,
sentences.zh: 其实我昨天给我丈夫发了短信，我说，

sentences.en: I would come back to Marupo, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想回到马里乌波尔，你知道的。

sentences.en: And he said, you can't do that.
sentences.zh: 他说，你不能那样做。

sentences.en: What does it mean you will come back?
sentences.zh: 你说你要回来是什么意思？

sentences.en: Nobody will let you go.
sentences.zh: 没人会让你走的。

sentences.en: You probably will be killed, you know, if you try to get back.
sentences.zh: 如果你试图回去，你很可能会被杀，你知道的。

sentences.en: No, Marina, no.
sentences.zh: 不，玛丽娜，不行。

sentences.en: People are trying to leave and you are trying to come back.
sentences.zh: 人们都在试图离开，而你却试图回去。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's love.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这就是爱。

sentences.en: And my husband said to me yesterday that try to find a job in Vyv.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫昨天对我说，试着在利沃夫找份工作。

sentences.en: And he said, I don't know if I will stay alive.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不知道我能不能活下来。

sentences.en: So you should care about yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以你应该照顾好你自己。

sentences.en: But I'm sitting here and I don't know what should I do.
sentences.zh: 但我坐在这里，不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Should I move from Lviv?
sentences.zh: 我应该离开利沃夫吗？

sentences.en: And it's worrying me because it feels like if I leave the Ukraine, it feels like I'm running, you know.
sentences.zh: 这让我很担心，因为感觉如果我离开乌克兰，就像是在逃跑，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I just wish, I don't need the flats.
sentences.zh: 我只希望，我不需要公寓。

sentences.en: I don't need the property.
sentences.zh: 我不需要财产。

sentences.en: I don't need anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都不需要。

sentences.en: I just wish my parents to be alive.
sentences.zh: 我只希望我的父母能活着。

sentences.en: But my husband's sleeping on the floor and actually, and trying to help other people.
sentences.zh: 但我丈夫睡在地板上，还在试图帮助其他人。

sentences.en: So I do worry about my husband.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实很担心我的丈夫。

sentences.en: And I said to him, if you have a chance, leave.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，如果有机会，就离开。

sentences.en: He is the biggest love of my life, I should say.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，他是我一生中最爱的人。

sentences.en: So I can give even my life instead of for him, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我甚至可以为了他献出生命，真的。

sentences.en: I'm not kidding.
sentences.zh: 我没开玩笑。

sentences.en: So when I left, I told him, please try to save your life because I'm going to die if something happens to you, really.
sentences.zh: 所以我离开时告诉他，请一定要活下去，因为如果你出了什么事，我会活不下去的，真的。

sentences.en: And you should know that you are the biggest love of my life, you know.
sentences.zh: 你要知道你是我一生中最爱的人，你知道的。

sentences.en: He said you are mine as well.
sentences.zh: 他说你也是我的挚爱。

sentences.en: And now, I don't even know if I'm going to see him again.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我甚至不知道还能不能再见到他。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the Russian bombardment of Mariupol touched off international outrage when it struck a maternity hospital.
sentences.zh: 周三，俄罗斯对马里乌波尔的轰炸击中了一家妇产医院，引发了国际公愤。

sentences.en: The attack sent pregnant women, many of them bloodied and clutching their stomachs, fleeing the hospital.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后，孕妇们纷纷逃离医院，许多人浑身是血，紧紧捂着肚子。

sentences.en: According to the Ukrainian authorities, 17 people were injured in the attack and three were killed, including a child.
sentences.zh: 据乌克兰当局称，袭击造成17人受伤，3人死亡，其中包括一名儿童。

sentences.en: Across the city, conditions continued to deteriorate.
sentences.zh: 在整个城市，情况持续恶化。

sentences.en: Ukrainian officials said that a six-year-old child died from dehydration as parts of the city lost water.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰官员表示，由于城市部分地区断水，一名六岁儿童死于脱水。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Early this morning, the foreign ministers of Russia and Ukraine met in the highest level talks since the war began.
sentences.zh: 今天清晨，俄罗斯和乌克兰的外交部长举行了自战争开始以来最高级别的会谈。

sentences.en: They failed to agree on terms for a ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 他们未能就停火条款达成一致。

sentences.en: Nor did they agree to form safe corridors to allow Ukrainians to flee areas of Russian bombardment.
sentences.zh: 他们也没有同意建立安全走廊，以允许乌克兰人逃离俄罗斯的轰炸区。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Russian officials accused the United States of waging a, quote, economic war against them by banning the importation of Russian oil.
sentences.zh: 周三，俄罗斯官员指责美国通过禁止进口俄罗斯石油，对他们发动了所谓的“经济战”。

sentences.en: They also threatened to seize the assets of Western businesses like Starbucks and McDonald's that have suspended operations in Russia because of the war.
sentences.zh: 他们还威胁要没收星巴克和麦当劳等西方企业的资产，这些企业因战争已暂停在俄罗斯的业务。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Washington, Congress finalized a nearly $14 billion package of military and humanitarian aid for Ukraine, a bipartisan show of support
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在华盛顿，国会敲定了一项近140亿美元的对乌克兰军事和人道主义援助计划，这是两党对乌克兰抗击俄罗斯的支持。

sentences.en: for Ukraine's fight against Russia.
sentences.zh: 支持乌克兰抗击俄罗斯。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争中。
